scripts.test: npm run build:types && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run test:types && npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared-types/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/client/tsconfig.app.json
scripts.clean:db: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d=p.resolve('apps/server/data');if(fs.existsSync(d))fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>f.startsWith('kanban-data')).forEach(f=>fs.unlinkSync(p.join(d,f)));console.log('[SQLite] Base de datos reseteada con exito.');"
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/client
